newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Holtzbrinck unit's stake in N-TV.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Holtzbrinck unit's stake in N-TV.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had cleared the acquisition of joint control of the German news channel N-TV by a subsidiary of publishing group von Holtzbrinck.

"The Commission has given the green light to the acquisition of joint control of the German news channel N-TV by a subsidiary of Verlagsgruppe Handelsblatt GmbH, which is part of the publishing group von Holtzbrinck," the Commission said in a statement.
In August the Commission named the subsidiary as GWF, Gesellschaft fuer Wirtschaftsversehen mbH.
It said in Wednesday's statement that control of N-TV was shared with a subsidiary of U.S. media company Time Warner and CNN Germany, a unit of U.S. media company Turner Broadcasting.

"The concentration is not likely to lead to the creation or strengthening of a dominant market position," the Commission said adding that the market share of N-TV in the German television advertising market was low. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
